facts.fact: 宫廷表面和睦地护送 Isen 的灵柩北行
她觉得自己与 Tilde 的私情像在兄长坟上做爱
facts.anchor: like they had made love on her brother’s grave

facts.fact: 路上又出现一道新的荆棘墙
荆豆反季开花，黑莓沉得压枝
墙中央吊着一只开膛的天鹅
facts.anchor: hung a dead swan, its belly open

facts.fact: Dagobert 以「翼的旨意」力主穿林
facts.anchor: We will go through the wood

facts.fact: Tilde 在议事时主张稳妥撤退
facts.anchor: the wisdom of a strong retreat

facts.fact: 夜里林间鸟兽之声骤起骤歇，众人惊惧
facts.anchor: all the sound was from their own hooves
